text: The Medical Officer of Health will give a presentation on the 2019 Toronto Public Health operating and capital budgets.

The Board of Health Budget Committee: 1. Directed the Medical Officer of Health to bring forward a 2019 budget that maximizes provincial cost-shared funding opportunities. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 from the Medical Officer of Health remain confidential, as it pertains to personal matters about identifiable individuals, including municipal or local board employees, and labour relations and employee negotiations.
